p0_closed: --json ORed FEATURE_JSON_BRIDGE into the offered hello, so a transport flag moved the negotiated profile, the handshake identity, and the session authority, contradicting the owns-no-semantics claim; raised by ariadne. The offer carries no transport feature in either mode: the endpoint offers Server::offered_hello unedited, so the same client hello over the same repository negotiates the same session in both modes and JSON opens succeed; pinned by the mode-independence handshake test and the rule audit's transport-feature ban. Neither literal prescription survived contact with the transcript binding (per-mode advertisement would fork identity by mode and break opens against the digest; always-offer would claim an unexercised JSON capability in byte mode)

section 6 required byte-identical JSON-mode answers but the test compared only method, request id, bounds, and body length; raised by ariadne. The old comparison's digest rationale described the bit-carrying behavior correctly (the server-hello bit entered the transcript-bound handshake, and the two modes transplanted different sessions), and is now obsolete: the JSON test runs the same session in both modes and asserts byte-identical answers, with only the freshly minted open identities differing

byte-mode stdout was never flushed and main exits via process::exit, with all tests driving run() over Vec<u8>, so the sley binary and the process boundary had zero evidence; raised by nabu. Every answer now flushes before the next frame is read with a final flush at exit (flush failure is CLI_IO_FAILURE, section 2 obligation), and a subprocess test drives the real binary over pipes proving unfragmented byte delivery and exit-status propagation. Exit-time truncation did not reproduce on this toolchain (572-byte newline-free and 63KB payloads cross intact); the flush stands as the liveness guarantee and defense in depth

the endpoint mutated Server::offered_hello with FEATURE_JSON_BRIDGE under --json, folding a transport flag into SelectedProfile, handshake_id, and SessionAuthority; raised by vulcan with direction offer-always. Closed by offering-never instead: the negotiated hello is always the server's unedited offer (the endpoint edits no hello anywhere), and always-offer was rejected as a false JSON capability claim in byte mode per nabu; pinned by the same mode-independence test and audit ban

The contract now defines the owned inventory as exactly the forward closure the frozen S20-250 fingerprint walks, with back-references verified by fingerprint_function, and the counts as the lengths of the fingerprint input vectors; the implementation collects exactly that closure, so disagreement fails COMPARE_INVENTORY_INVALID with the exact FINGERPRINT_* code preserved and no divergent SemanticDeltaId can result (contract revision 2).

collateral seed rule excluded unchanged-with-body-delta functions that the implementation and the oracle both seed; raised by nabu (P0-1) and as ariadne P1-5 and vulcan P1-1. The contract now seeds every entity carrying a body delta into both seed sets and defines collateral as closure members bound by both roots carrying no entity delta, matching the implementation, the oracle, and the frozen body-only vector (contract revision 2).

no frozen digest bound the derivation semantics (change classes, field table, relation rule, collateral formula, ordering rules, code table); raised by nabu (P0-2). p0_closed: the two-operation handle was not a capability boundary: exchange.__func__.__globals__ reached Endpoint, subprocess, Trace and Path and _exchange.__closure__ reached the live session, so section 2's 'nothing else existed' and ADR-0036's 'mechanically audited' were false; raised independently by ariadne, nabu and vulcan. EndpointHandle now lives in a module importing nothing privileged (reflected_privileged_names is empty and gated per trial and in the checker), and the contract states the irreducible closure residual as trust rather than denying it

context_bytes counted only capsule and query.* bodies while the agent also received refs.list, handle.expand, candidate.inspect, compare, revision.read, execute, report and diagnostics bodies, understating the arm under test against master goal 21.6; it now counts every body the agent received, and derive_context_breakdown records the split in this package's own evidence rather than widening the S20-610 metric field set
